definitions.explanation: The red liquid that circulates through the body. Also used metaphorically for lineage or temperament.

examples.english: You're bleeding. / Blood is coming out.

examples.japanese: {血液型|けつえきがた}は{何型|なにがた}ですか。
examples.notes: 血液 is the formal/medical term

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}の{血|ち}を{引|ひ}いている。
examples.english: I take after my father. (lit. I inherit my father's blood)

notes:
{血|ち} is the common word for blood; {血液|けつえき} is more formal/medical.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {血|ち}が{出|で}る: to bleed
- {血|ち}を{流|なが}す: to shed blood
- {血|ち}の{気|け}が{引|ひ}く: to turn pale
- {血|ち}を{引|ひ}く: to inherit (bloodline)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {血液|けつえき}: blood (medical/formal)
- {血液型|けつえきがた}: blood type
- {献血|けんけつ}: blood donation
- {出血|しゅっけつ}: bleeding

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, blood type ({血液型|けつえきがた}) is popularly believed to indicate personality traits.
